text:
mira: Hey infra — heads up: we have a customer livestream demo next Tue 09:00 APAC requiring sustained low-latency A100s for 2 hours. Can we confirm capacity or a short-term borrow plan? :eyes:

samir: @mira can you share expected concurrent sessions / tokens/s? makes triage faster.

mira: ~6 concurrent sessions, ~1k tokens/sec aggregate, must avoid preemptions during demo window.

samir: OK. Current apac pool has 8 A100s but 3 are reserved for Dedicated commitments. That leaves 5 available; preemptible mix is 2 of those. So hard-safe A100s = 3.

jang: We could do a cross-region borrow from eu-west1 demo pool for the 2 hour window and route traffic via nearest POP if latency delta is acceptable.

mira: latency from eu -> apac would be ~140ms one-way, too high for interactive demo. Prefer staying in APAC.

samir: Understood. Options: 1) swap some reserved demo capacity (low churn) for that slot (needs contract check), 2) a short-term vendor burst (3-6 A100s) — procurement ETA ~48h, or 3) convert preemptible nodes to non-preemptible for 2 hours and add eviction-safeguard (taint+nodelabel) to avoid placement elsewhere.

sarah: Doing (3) is fastest but increases cost + risk we break other test jobs. We'd need to cordon test namespaces.

mira: (3) sounds fine if we can gate test jobs. How do we flip preemptible -> persistent for a short window?

samir: Two commands:
```bash
# mark nodes as non-preemptible in k8s layer (adds label)
kubectl label nodes a100-node-123 a100-node-124 redwood/ephemeral=locked --overwrite
# cordon test namespace (drain not needed for short window)
kubectl taint nodes a100-node-123 maintenance=true:NoSchedule || true
```
Doable in 15-30m. Will need oncall to run with approval.

devops-bot: Note: There is a scheduled vendor maintenance in apac on Sat 03:00-05:00 UTC — no impact to Tue demo window.

mike: I can raise a procurement fast-track for vendor burst but need approval doc + estimated cost. What budget code?

sarah: Cost estimate: ~USD 2.4k for 3 A100s for 2 hours on vendor burst. Budget code ENG-DEMO-23.

mike: Thanks — opening ticket now.

procurement-bot: Procurement ticket created: PRQ-4321 — vendor burst request for 3x A100 in apac. Link: https://requisitions.internal/PRQ-4321 :package:

samir: Quick note on eviction safeguards: we'll add node annotation redwood/priority=demo and a placement policy to avoid autoscaler touching those nodes during the window. Also set a fallback policy to spin up eu nodes if anything fails.

mira: @samir appreciate that. Can you also add a quick health check that pings model endpoint every 30s and alerts to #eng-oncall? we want early detection of perf degradation.

samir: yep — will push a lightweight prometheus job + alert rule. I will run the node label + taint ops once procurement confirms or we decide to convert preemptibles.

mira: If procurement is slower than 12h, go with preemptible->persistent plan. Please proceed and post exact node names you touched.

mike: Procurement ETA update: vendor responded, can get 3 A100s provisioned in ~36h if we sign NDA; otherwise 72h. Marking PRQ-4321 as high priority.

procurement-bot: PRQ-4321 status: vendor awaiting NDA signature. Contact: vendor+ops@partnercloud.com

jang: Just a reminder — if we convert preemptibles, we should tag test jobs with `pool=demo-exempt` so autoscaler doesn't reschedule them accidentally.

sarah: I'll push a quick patch to CI job templates to add that tag for the demo run.

samir: Plan agreed: (A) try vendor burst if NDA signed within 12h; (B) else, convert preemptible nodes to persistent + add redwood/priority=demo label + placement safeties + alerting. Samir will execute and post node list.

mira: Great. Please ping here when done. :thumbsup:

samir: Will do. ETA for (B) ops ~45m after decision.

mira: Thanks team — marking this thread as the single source for updates.
